vkh_error_at_full_depletion_pct.note: the VKH deficit at gamma = 1000 on the worst curve, -3.7327e-4 % in closed form, matched to 2e-5 of itself; its spread over three BLAS kernels (about 1e-4 of itself) is round-off in F_A divided by a deficit of 1e-5: held to a band of the old 5 %

beta_interface_at_axis_end.note: |beta(0)| at gamma = 1000 on the worst curve: exponentially small in gamma, so what the solve returns is solver noise far below the Newton tolerance on unknowns of order one

depletion_falls_steps.note: steps of ln beta(0), gamma = 0.5 to 100 on the worst curve, falling by more than 1e-6

constancy_rises_steps.note: steps of the ln constancy ratio, gamma = 0.5 to 100 on the worst curve, rising by more than 1e-6

inst_deficit_routes_max_rel_diff.note: two methods on the M_H = 800 deficit E_i - F_A, about 1.3e-5 of F_A, so round-off in F_A is amplified; measured 8.4e-5 to 9.0e-5 across BLAS kernels, far below the overstatement factor it supports

fv_vs_bvp_max_rel_diff.note: one graded n_x = 800 solve against collocation at tol 1e-10 over 20 chart points, set by its second-order discretisation

fv_vs_bvp_max_abs_diff_beta.note: beta(0), the same two solvers and points

ref_vs_bvp_max_rel_diff.note: the Richardson reference against collocation at tol 1e-10

first_integral_max_abs_resid.note: |q beta(0) - (1 + q - F_A)|/(1 + q) on the reference, never told to the discretisation; its size is the Newton tolerance

vkh_two_routes_max_rel_diff.note: the implicit relation solved for F_A and for gamma', Brent at xtol 1e-13, rtol 8.9e-16

vkh_pfo_limit_max_rel_error.note: evaluated at q = 1e10, so the finite-q error is about gamma/(2q), 1.5e-8 at gamma = 300

vkh_instantaneous_limit_rel_error.note: evaluated at gamma = 1e6, where the deficit q(1+q)^2/gamma^2 is 3.8e-10 of 1 + q = 20

fv_convergence_order.note: second-order finite volumes; the order farthest from 2 from successive differences of F_A at (10, 4) on the graded 100-800 ladder

fv_ladder_over_newton_tol.note: finest relative successive difference of the ladder over the Newton tolerance: the orders measure the grid, not the solver

fv_rel_error_n800_uniform.note: uniform n_x = 800 error at (10, 4) against collocation at tol 1e-11, 7.6e-9; against the Richardson reference 7.7e-9 and against the (800, 1600) extrapolations 8.0e-9 and 8.3e-9, so the reference is the larger uncertainty; its spread over three BLAS kernels (about 7e-5 of itself) is round-off in F_A: held to a bound

grading_cost_ratio.note: graded over uniform n_x = 800 error at (10, 4); its denominator is a bound, so the ratio is a bound too

f31_cold_own_grid_rel.note: F3.1's VKH-error definition recomputed cold on its own grid against its stored value; measured 1.0e-11, F3.1's number spreads 5e-12 across kernels

f31_stored_vs_recomputed_rel.note: this page's recomputation of F3.1's definition against F3.1's committed vkh_max_error_pct; the residual is F3.1's uniform n_x = 400 discretisation, and F3.1's own number spreads 5e-12 across kernels

f31_first_order_reproduced_rel.note: F3.1's first_order_max_rel_error recomputed on its uniform n_x = 400 grid; measured 6.3e-15, made by F3.1 on another machine
